name: @ownmail/template
description: The ownmail mailbox + calendar app template (TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.dev:ui: OWNMAIL_DEV_MOCKS=1 SESSION_SECRET=ownmail-dev-session-secret-change-me NYLAS_API_KEY=dev NYLAS_CLIENT_ID=dev NYLAS_REGION=us APP_NAME=ownmail-dev INBOX_EMAIL=ada@ownmail.com TEMPLATE_VERSION=0.1.0 vite dev -c vite.config.local.ts --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build:vercel: vite build -c vite.config.vercel.ts --outDir dist-vercel && node scripts/build-vercel.mjs
